areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: General objective and specific objectives directly tied to the area; core components and most resources (roughly 90%) go to the flagship hospital; efficiency indicators; high replicable impact.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: General objective relevant but not directly related; a research-centre objective, a dedicated component and one SMART indicator exist, but the resource share is small.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Replicable hospital model contributes to state capacity with high impact potential, but no components or resources are formally allocated to it.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital features of the hospital do not link clearly to digital transformation across government levels; the programme is mainly construction of one unit.

areas.name: International cooperation and regional development
areas.reason: Cooperation with a multilateral lender is financing, not the programme's purpose, and is common to all proposals.

not_accepted.name: Digital government
not_accepted.reason: Digital features of the hospital do not link clearly to digital transformation across government levels; the programme is mainly construction of one unit.

not_accepted.name: International cooperation and regional development
not_accepted.reason: Cooperation with a multilateral lender is financing, not the programme's purpose, and is common to all proposals.
